```html
<div class="wu-stat">
  <span class="wu-stat-label">Active users</span>
  <span class="wu-stat-value">1,284</span>
  <span class="wu-stat-delta success" data-trend="up">+12% from last month</span>
</div>
```

```html
<div class="wu-stat lg">
  <span class="wu-stat-label">Open tickets</span>
  <span class="wu-stat-value">37</span>
  <span class="wu-stat-delta" data-trend="down">-5 this week</span>
</div>
```

### Modifiers

| Modifier | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sm`, `lg` | Smaller or larger value | 1.0.0 |
| `success`, `danger` | On the change line: success or danger text color | 1.0.0 |

### Parts

| Part | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wu-stat-label` | Muted label | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-stat-value` | Large value | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-stat-delta` | Change line, muted by default | 1.0.0 |

### States

| State | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data-trend="up"`, `data-trend="down"` | On the change line: draws an up or down arrow | 1.0.0 |

## table

Data table with sticky header and columns, selection, expandable rows, truncated cells, a summary row and striped styles.

Put a wide table in a `wu-table-scroll` region with `tabindex="0"`, `role="region"` and an `aria-label`; it shows scroll shadows on the sides with more content. Sticky columns need that region.

The select-all checkbox and expandable rows need the kit script; everything else is CSS. Sorting the rows and updating `aria-sort` is up to your script.

A truncated cell takes the full text in core's `data-tooltip` and `tabindex="0"`. `aria-selected` on a row is valid only in a `role="grid"` table.

- Root class: `wu-table`
- Sass entry: `@use "@wovenui/components/table";`
- Needs: none
- JavaScript: optional: `initTable` from `@wovenui/components/js`
- Since: 1.0.0

### Markup

```html
<div class="wu-table-scroll" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Invoices">
  <table class="wu-table striped hover">
    <caption>Open invoices</caption>
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th scope="col">Invoice</th>
        <th scope="col" class="wu-table-num">Amount</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><th scope="row">INV-1042</th><td class="wu-table-num">$1,200.00</td></tr>
      <tr><th scope="row">INV-1043</th><td class="wu-table-num">$340.00</td></tr>
    </tbody>
    <tfoot><tr><th scope="row">Total</th><td class="wu-table-num">$1,540.00</td></tr></tfoot>
  </table>
</div>
```

```html
<table class="wu-table">
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th scope="col" class="wu-table-select"><input type="checkbox" class="wu-checkbox-input" aria-label="Select all rows"></th>
      <th scope="col" aria-sort="ascending"><button class="wu-table-sort" type="button">Name</button></th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td class="wu-table-select"><input type="checkbox" class="wu-checkbox-input" aria-label="Select Ana Lopez"></td>
      <th scope="row"><button class="wu-table-expand" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Details for Ana Lopez"></button> Ana Lopez</th>
    </tr>
    <tr class="wu-table-detail" hidden><td colspan="2">Owner since 2021</td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
```

```html
<table class="wu-table">
  <tbody>
    <tr><td class="wu-table-truncate" tabindex="0" data-tooltip="Typo on the billing page"><span>Typo on the billing page</span></td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
```

### Modifiers

| Modifier | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sm` | Tighter cell padding | 1.0.0 |
| `striped` | Tint on every second body row | 1.0.0 |
| `hover` | Tint on the row under the pointer | 1.0.0 |
| `bordered` | Outer border with rounded corners and borders between cells | 1.0.0 |
| `sticky-header` | Header cells stick to the top of the page, or of the scroll region when `--wu-table--MaxHeight` is set | 1.0.0 |
| `sticky-start`, `sticky-end` | First or last column sticks inside a `wu-table-scroll` region, with an edge shadow on the scrolling side | 1.0.0 |
| `animated` | Spring turn of the expand chevron when the user allows motion; `wu-animated` on an ancestor does the same | 1.0.0 |

### Parts

| Part | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wu-table-scroll` | Scroll region for a wide table, with scroll shadows | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-table-num` | Cell with end-aligned numbers in tabular figures | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-table-select` | Cell of a checkbox column, as narrow as its checkbox | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-table-truncate` | Cell whose text child stays on one line with an ellipsis | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-table-sort` | Button in a header cell that shows sort arrows | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-table-expand` | Button with `aria-expanded` that shows or hides the detail row | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-table-detail` | Row after an expandable row, with the alternate background | 1.0.0 |

### Variables

| Variable | Default | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--wu-table--Background` | `var(--wu-bg-surface)` | Background that scroll shadows and sticky cells blend into | 1.0.0 |
| `--wu-table--MaxHeight` | `none` | Maximum height of the scroll region, so the header can stick inside it | 1.0.0 |
| `--wu-table--TruncateWidth` | `16rem` | Maximum width of a truncated cell text | 1.0.0 |

### States

| State | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-sort="ascending"`, `aria-sort="descending"` | On a header cell: one arrow on the sort button and regular text color | 1.0.0 |
| `aria-expanded="true"` | On an expand button: the chevron points down | 1.0.0 |
| `aria-selected="true"` | On a row: selected tint and a bar at the start of the first cell; a checked `wu-table-select` box does the same | 1.0.0 |

## tabs

Tabs that show one panel at a time, following the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern, in line, card, boxed and vertical styles.

The kit script adds arrow keys, Home and End, switches the panels and fills in roles, ids, `aria-controls`, `aria-labelledby` and `tabindex` when they are missing. Without it the first panel shows.

In `vertical` tabs the script sets `aria-orientation="vertical"` on the list; without the script, add it yourself.

- Root class: `wu-tabs`
- Sass entry: `@use "@wovenui/components/tabs";`
- Needs: none
- JavaScript: required: `initTabs` from `@wovenui/components/js`
- Since: 1.0.0

### Markup

```html
<div class="wu-tabs">
  <div class="wu-tabs-list" role="tablist" aria-label="Account">
    <button class="wu-tabs-tab" type="button" role="tab" id="tab-profile" aria-controls="panel-profile" aria-selected="true">Profile</button>
    <button class="wu-tabs-tab" type="button" role="tab" id="tab-billing" aria-controls="panel-billing" aria-selected="false" tabindex="-1">Billing</button>
  </div>
  <div class="wu-tabs-panel" role="tabpanel" id="panel-profile" aria-labelledby="tab-profile" tabindex="0">Profile settings</div>
  <div class="wu-tabs-panel" role="tabpanel" id="panel-billing" aria-labelledby="tab-billing" tabindex="0" hidden>Billing settings</div>
</div>
```

```html
<div class="wu-tabs vertical boxed">
  <div class="wu-tabs-list" role="tablist" aria-label="Settings" aria-orientation="vertical">
    <button class="wu-tabs-tab" type="button" role="tab" id="tab-general" aria-controls="panel-general" aria-selected="true">General</button>
    <button class="wu-tabs-tab" type="button" role="tab" id="tab-team" aria-controls="panel-team" aria-selected="false" tabindex="-1" disabled>Team</button>
  </div>
  <div class="wu-tabs-panel" role="tabpanel" id="panel-general" aria-labelledby="tab-general" tabindex="0">General settings</div>
  <div class="wu-tabs-panel" role="tabpanel" id="panel-team" aria-labelledby="tab-team" tabindex="0" hidden>Team settings</div>
</div>
```

### Modifiers

| Modifier | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `card` | Joined tab boxes; the selected tab opens into the panel | 1.0.0 |
| `boxed` | Tabs and panels inside one bordered box | 1.0.0 |
| `vertical` | Tab list at the inline start, selected bar on its inline end edge | 1.0.0 |
| `animated` | Selected bar grows from the center and the panel fades in when the user allows motion; `wu-animated` on an ancestor does the same | 1.0.0 |

### Parts

| Part | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wu-tabs-list` | Row of tabs; scrolls sideways and fades the edge with more tabs | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-tabs-tab` | One tab button; a direct child `svg` is sized to `1em` | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-tabs-panel` | Content shown for the selected tab | 1.0.0 |

### States

| State | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-selected="true"` | On a tab: regular text color and a brand bar | 1.0.0 |
| `disabled`, `aria-disabled="true"` | On a tab: half opacity and a not-allowed cursor | 1.0.0 |

## tag

Label for a category or a filter, in seven hues, as plain text, a link or a button.

A link or button tag gets a pointer, a hover color and the focus ring. `aria-pressed` on a button tag makes a checkable filter chip; toggling the attribute is up to your script.

A direct child `svg` is sized to `1em`. The remove button needs an `aria-label` that names the tag.

- Root class: `wu-tag`
- Sass entry: `@use "@wovenui/components/tag";`
- Needs: none
- JavaScript: none, CSS only
- Since: 1.0.0

### Markup

```html
<span class="wu-tag">Design</span>
<span class="wu-tag blue">Frontend</span>
```

```html
<div role="group" aria-label="Filter by topic">
  <button class="wu-tag" type="button" aria-pressed="true">Design</button>
  <button class="wu-tag" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Research</button>
</div>
```

```html
<span class="wu-tag purple">Research <button class="wu-tag-remove" type="button" aria-label="Remove Research"></button></span>
```

### Modifiers

| Modifier | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gray`, `red`, `blue`, `green`, `yellow`, `purple`, `pink` | Hue color: subtle background, hue border and hue text | 1.0.0 |

### Parts

| Part | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wu-tag-remove` | Remove button inside the tag, its cross drawn in CSS | 1.0.0 |

### States

| State | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-pressed="true"` | On a button tag: brand tint, ring and a check mark | 1.0.0 |

Body text on any element, with relaxed leading and space between paragraphs in a row.

## textarea

Multi-line field with a bounded height that grows with the content, where the browser supports it.

Core base already styles a `textarea` like an input (border, focus ring, invalid border, disabled). The kit adds the radius, the type size and a height between three and twelve lines.

Growth uses `field-sizing: content`, and `rows` is ignored there.

- Root class: `wu-textarea`
- Sass entry: `@use "@wovenui/components/textarea";`
- Needs: none
- JavaScript: none, CSS only
- Since: 1.0.0

### Markup

```html
<div class="wu-field">
  <label class="wu-field-label" for="textarea-notes">Notes</label>
  <textarea class="wu-textarea" id="textarea-notes">Type more lines to see the field grow.</textarea>
</div>
```

```html
<textarea class="wu-textarea" aria-label="Short note" style="--wu-textarea--MinHeight: 2.5rem; --wu-textarea--MaxHeight: 6rem">One line to start.</textarea>
```

### Variables

| Variable | Default | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--wu-textarea--MinHeight` | `3 lines plus padding and border` | Minimum height | 1.0.0 |
| `--wu-textarea--MaxHeight` | `12 lines plus padding and border` | Maximum height | 1.0.0 |

### States

| State | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `:disabled` | Not-allowed cursor and no resize | 1.0.0 |
| `readonly` | Alternate background | 1.0.0 |
| `aria-invalid="true"`, `:user-invalid` | Danger border doubled to 2px, so the change is not color alone | 1.0.0 |

## timeline

Ordered list of events with markers and a rail, role colors and a progress mode.

Role words on an item color its marker; `success`, `warning` and `danger` also change the marker shape, so color is not the only cue.

With `aria-current="step"` on one item the list becomes a progress rail: earlier items filled, the current one ringed, later ones hollow. Say "completed" in the item text too.

- Root class: `wu-timeline`
- Sass entry: `@use "@wovenui/components/timeline";`
- Needs: none
- JavaScript: none, CSS only
- Since: 1.0.0

### Markup

```html
<ol class="wu-timeline">
  <li class="wu-timeline-item success">
    <p class="wu-timeline-title">Order shipped</p>
    <time class="wu-timeline-time" datetime="2026-03-02">2 March</time>
    <p class="wu-timeline-text">Handed to the carrier.</p>
  </li>
  <li class="wu-timeline-item danger">
    <p class="wu-timeline-title">Payment failed</p>
    <time class="wu-timeline-time" datetime="2026-03-01">1 March</time>
  </li>
</ol>
```

```html
<ol class="wu-timeline">
  <li class="wu-timeline-item"><p class="wu-timeline-title">Cart (completed)</p></li>
  <li class="wu-timeline-item" aria-current="step"><p class="wu-timeline-title">Payment</p></li>
  <li class="wu-timeline-item"><p class="wu-timeline-title">Confirmation</p></li>
</ol>
```

### Modifiers

| Modifier | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `brand`, `info` | On an item: marker color | 1.0.0 |
| `success`, `warning`, `danger` | On an item: marker color and a check, triangle or octagon shape | 1.0.0 |
| `animated` | Each rail segment draws once as it scrolls into view when the user allows motion; `wu-animated` on an ancestor does the same | 1.0.0 |

### Parts

| Part | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wu-timeline-item` | One event: a marker, a rail to the next item and the content | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-timeline-title` | Event title in medium weight | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-timeline-time` | Muted time or date line | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-timeline-text` | Muted description | 1.0.0 |

### States

| State | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-current="step"` | On an item: the current step, ringed; earlier items fill and later ones turn hollow | 1.0.0 |

Pick the heading level for the document outline and the size for the look.



### Modifiers

## toast

Short notification in a corner of the viewport, shown in a polite live region.

The region sits at the bottom end corner by default and scrolls when the toasts are taller than the viewport. The title text carries the meaning, not the color.

`toast("Saved")` from the kit script adds a toast, and the region when the page has none. It closes the toast after a delay, pauses on hover and focus, keeps at most three open and skips a repeat of an open message.

Create the region at page load; a region added together with its first toast may not be announced.

- Root class: `wu-toast`
- Sass entry: `@use "@wovenui/components/toast";`
- Needs: none
- JavaScript: required: `toast`, `dismiss` from `@wovenui/components/js`
- Since: 1.0.0

### Markup

```html
<section class="wu-toast-region animated" aria-live="polite" aria-label="Notifications">
  <div class="wu-toast success">
    <p class="wu-toast-title">Saved</p>
    <p>Your changes are live.</p>
    <button class="wu-toast-close" type="button" aria-label="Close"></button>
  </div>
</section>
```

```html
<section class="wu-toast-region top-end" aria-live="polite" aria-label="Notifications"></section>
```

### Modifiers

| Modifier | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `brand`, `success`, `danger`, `warning`, `info` | On a toast: role color on the start edge and the title | 1.0.0 |
| `top-start`, `top-end`, `bottom-start` | On the region: moves it to another corner; the default is the bottom end corner | 1.0.0 |
| `animated` | On the region: toasts slide in, fade out and stack behind the newest, fanning out on hover or focus; `wu-animated` on an ancestor does the same | 1.0.0 |

### Parts

| Part | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wu-toast-region` | Fixed live region that holds the toasts; hidden when empty | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-toast-title` | Toast title in semibold weight | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-toast-close` | Close button with `aria-label`, its cross drawn in CSS | 1.0.0 |

### Variables

| Variable | Default | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--wu-toast--Width` | `22rem` | Width of the toasts in the region | 1.0.0 |

### States

| State | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hidden` | On a toast: removed from layout, after a fade out with `animated` | 1.0.0 |
| `:empty` | A region with no toasts is hidden | 1.0.0 |

## toggle

On and off switch built on a native checkbox with `role="switch"`.

The track is 2.25em by 1.25em with a 1em thumb, so it follows the root type size and the `sm` and `lg` steps.

- Root class: `wu-toggle`
- Sass entry: `@use "@wovenui/components/toggle";`
- Needs: none
- JavaScript: none, CSS only
- Since: 1.0.0

### Markup

```html
<label class="wu-toggle">
  <input class="wu-toggle-input" type="checkbox" role="switch" checked>
  <span class="wu-toggle-label">Email notifications</span>
</label>
```

```html
<label class="wu-toggle lg animated">
  <input class="wu-toggle-input" type="checkbox" role="switch" aria-invalid="true">
  <span class="wu-toggle-label">Accept the terms</span>
</label>
```

### Modifiers

| Modifier | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sm`, `lg` | Smaller or larger switch and label | 1.0.0 |
| `animated` | Spring thumb when the user allows motion; `wu-animated` on an ancestor does the same | 1.0.0 |

### Parts

| Part | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wu-toggle-input` | The checkbox: track and thumb | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-toggle-label` | Label text beside the switch | 1.0.0 |

### States

| State | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `:checked` | Brand track and the thumb moved to the end | 1.0.0 |
| `disabled` | Half opacity and a not-allowed cursor | 1.0.0 |
| `aria-invalid="true"`, `:user-invalid` | Danger outline | 1.0.0 |

## toolbar

Wrapping row of controls, with groups, separators, an end group and a boxed variant.

A toolbar holds controls of one height, so it lines up by itself. Status displays such as tags and badges go outside the row.

`role="toolbar"` promises arrow-key focus, so add it only with a script that provides it; otherwise use a plain `div`.

- Root class: `wu-toolbar`
- Sass entry: `@use "@wovenui/components/toolbar";`
- Needs: none
- JavaScript: none, CSS only
- Since: 1.0.0

### Markup

```html
<div class="wu-toolbar">
  <div class="wu-toolbar-group">
    <button class="wu-btn sm" type="button">Bold</button>
    <button class="wu-btn sm" type="button">Italic</button>
  </div>
  <span class="wu-toolbar-separator" aria-hidden="true"></span>
  <div class="wu-toolbar-end">
    <button class="wu-btn brand sm" type="button">Publish</button>
  </div>
</div>
```

```html
<div class="wu-toolbar boxed">
  <span class="wu-text sm">3 selected</span>
  <button class="wu-btn sm" type="button">Archive</button>
</div>
```

### Modifiers

| Modifier | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `boxed` | Border, padding and the alternate background | 1.0.0 |
| `sm` | Smaller gap | 1.0.0 |

### Parts

| Part | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wu-toolbar-group` | Controls that stay together | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-toolbar-separator` | Vertical line between groups | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-toolbar-end` | Pushes itself and what follows to the end | 1.0.0 |

## topbar

Application header with a brand, a scrolling nav, an end group, a pinned variant and a page progress line.

`wu-topbar-nav` works on the `nav` itself or on the `ul` inside it. When space runs out the nav scrolls first, then the brand truncates.

The bar stays in the flow; add `pinned` to stick it to the top. The progress line is decoration, so mark it `aria-hidden="true"`; it fills as the page scrolls and stays hidden when reduced motion is set.

- Root class: `wu-topbar`
- Sass entry: `@use "@wovenui/components/topbar";`
- Needs: none
- JavaScript: none, CSS only
- Since: 1.0.0

### Markup

```html
<header class="wu-topbar pinned">
  <a class="wu-topbar-brand" href="/">Acme</a>
  <nav aria-label="Main">
    <ul class="wu-topbar-nav">
      <li><a class="wu-topbar-link" href="/dashboard" aria-current="page">Dashboard</a></li>
      <li><a class="wu-topbar-link" href="/billing">Billing</a></li>
    </ul>
  </nav>
  <div class="wu-topbar-end">
    <button class="wu-btn sm" type="button">Sign out</button>
  </div>
  <div class="wu-topbar-progress" aria-hidden="true"></div>
</header>
```

```html
<header class="wu-topbar">
  <a class="wu-topbar-brand" href="/">Acme</a>
  <nav class="wu-topbar-nav" aria-label="Main">
    <a class="wu-topbar-link" href="/billing" aria-current="page">Billing</a>
    <a class="wu-topbar-link" href="/team">Team</a>
  </nav>
</header>
```

### Modifiers

| Modifier | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pinned` | Sticks to the top of its scroll container, with a shadow once stuck | 1.0.0 |

### Parts

| Part | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wu-topbar-brand` | Brand link or text; truncates last | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-topbar-nav` | Nav, or its list, that takes the free space and scrolls sideways | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-topbar-link` | Nav link; a direct child `svg` is sized to `1em` | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-topbar-end` | Group pushed to the inline end | 1.0.0 |
| `wu-topbar-progress` | Line along the bottom edge that fills as the page scrolls | 1.0.0 |

### States

| State | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-current="page"` | On a link: current page, brand underline | 1.0.0 |
